verses.before: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
verses.after: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the refuse heap,
verses.tsw_comparator: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,

verses.rationale: Retains repeated nobles and the social reversal.
verses.before: to make them sit with princes, with the princes of his people.
verses.after: to seat them with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
verses.tsw_comparator: to make them sit with princes, with the princes of his people.

verses.rationale: Keeps the woman's changed circumstance and concluding acclamation.
verses.before: He causes the barren woman to dwell in a house, as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD.
verses.after: He settles the childless woman in a home as a joyful mother of children. Praise YAH!
verses.tsw_comparator: He causes the barren woman to dwell in a house, as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves ancestral parallelism and linguistic estrangement.
verses.before: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,
verses.after: When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
verses.tsw_comparator: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

verses.rationale: Keeps sanctuary and rule as distinct metaphors.
verses.before: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.after: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his domain.
verses.tsw_comparator: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

verses.rationale: Preserves personified water reactions without specifying what was seen.
verses.before: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.
verses.after: The sea saw it and fled; the Jordan turned back.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.

verses.rationale: Keeps differentiated terrain and animals.
verses.before: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
verses.after: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

verses.rationale: Retains direct address and repeated questions.
verses.before: What troubles you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, that you turn back?
verses.after: What happened to you, sea, that you fled? And to you, Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.tsw_comparator: What troubles you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, that you turn back?

verses.rationale: Carries the question into the repeated animal comparison.
verses.before: O mountains, that you skip like rams? O hills, like lambs?
verses.after: Mountains, why did you skip like rams, and you hills, like lambs?
verses.tsw_comparator: O mountains, that you skip like rams? O hills, like lambs?

verses.rationale: Keeps the address and doubled divine presence.
verses.before: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.after: Tremble, earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
verses.tsw_comparator: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.rationale: Preserves both hard materials and transformed water forms.
verses.before: who turns the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of water.
verses.after: who turns rock into a pool of water, flint into flowing springs.
verses.tsw_comparator: who turns the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of water.

verses.rationale: Retains emphatic repetition and both grounds for glory.
verses.before: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness.
verses.after: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, because of your faithful love and faithfulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness.

verses.rationale: Preserves the taunt's question and now force.
verses.before: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
verses.after: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God now?”
verses.tsw_comparator: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

verses.rationale: Keeps heavenly location and freedom of action.
verses.before: Our God is in the heavens; God does whatever God pleases.
verses.after: Our God is in the heavens; he does whatever he pleases.
verses.tsw_comparator: Our God is in the heavens; God does whatever God pleases.

verses.rationale: Retains precious materials and human manufacture.
verses.before: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.after: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.

verses.rationale: Preserves the first two repeated bodily contrasts.
verses.before: They have mouths but do not speak; eyes, but do not see.
verses.after: They have mouths but cannot speak; they have eyes but cannot see.
verses.tsw_comparator: They have mouths but do not speak; eyes, but do not see.

verses.rationale: Keeps the next two sensory failures.
verses.before: They have ears but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.
verses.after: They have ears but cannot hear; they have noses but cannot smell.
verses.tsw_comparator: They have ears but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.

verses.rationale: Retains tactile, movement, and vocal incapacity.
verses.before: They have hands but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; no sound comes from their throats.
verses.after: They have hands but cannot feel, feet but cannot walk; no sound comes from their throats.
verses.tsw_comparator: They have hands but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; no sound comes from their throats.

verses.rationale: Preserves the image-makers' and worshipers' shared fate.
verses.before: People who make them become like them, as do everyone who trust in them.
verses.after: Those who make them become like them, as does everyone who trusts in them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

verses.rationale: Keeps address followed by third-person response.
verses.before: O Israel, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.
verses.after: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.tsw_comparator: O Israel, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.

verses.rationale: Preserves priestly address and identical response.
verses.before: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.
verses.after: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.tsw_comparator: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.

verses.rationale: Keeps both LORD occurrences and the wider audience.
verses.before: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.
verses.after: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.tsw_comparator: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! God is their help and their shield.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated blessing and the two named houses.
verses.before: The LORD has remembered us and will bless us; God will bless the house of Israel; God will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.after: The LORD has remembered us; he will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD has remembered us and will bless us; God will bless the house of Israel; God will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.rationale: Preserves inclusive social contrast without reducing it to age.
verses.before: God will bless people who fear the LORD, the small together with the great.
verses.after: He will bless those who fear the LORD, the small together with the great.
verses.tsw_comparator: God will bless those who fear the LORD, the small together with the great.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated you and generational growth.
verses.before: May the LORD increase you, you and your children.
verses.after: May the LORD make you increase, you and your children.
verses.tsw_comparator: May the LORD increase you, you and your children.

verses.rationale: Retains blessing grounded in the creator title.
verses.before: May you be blessed by the LORD, maker of heaven and earth.
verses.after: May you be blessed by the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: May you be blessed by the LORD, maker of heaven and earth.

verses.rationale: Keeps the distribution of heavens and earth.
verses.before: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but the earth God has given to humankind.
verses.after: The heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth he has given to humanity.
verses.tsw_comparator: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but the earth God has given to humankind.

verses.rationale: Preserves the death/silence claim without importing later theology.
verses.before: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.
verses.after: The dead do not praise YAH, nor do any who go down into silence.
verses.tsw_comparator: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.

verses.rationale: Keeps both short divine names and communal resolve.
verses.before: But we will bless the LORD from now and forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: But we will bless YAH from now and forever. Praise YAH!
verses.tsw_comparator: But we will bless the LORD from now and forever. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Supplies the natural object of love from the following clause.
verses.before: I love the LORD, because the LORD has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy.
verses.after: I love the LORD, for he hears my voice, my pleas for mercy.
verses.tsw_comparator: I love the LORD, because the LORD has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy.

verses.rationale: Preserves bodily listening image and lifelong response.
verses.before: Because the LORD inclined an ear to me, therefore I will call on the LORD as long as I live.
verses.after: Because he has bent his ear toward me, I will call on him throughout my days.
verses.tsw_comparator: Because the LORD inclined an ear to me, therefore I will call on the LORD as long as I live.

verses.rationale: Keeps cords, Sheol, and the three-part distress description.
verses.before: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of Sheol found me; I met distress and sorrow.
verses.after: The cords of death wrapped around me; the anguish of Sheol overtook me. I found only trouble and sorrow.
verses.tsw_comparator: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of Sheol found me; I met distress and sorrow.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated divine name and explicit life rescue.
verses.before: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, please deliver my life!”
verses.after: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “Please, LORD, save my life!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, please deliver my life!”

verses.rationale: Keeps all three attributes and communal our.
verses.before: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; our God is compassionate.
verses.after: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is compassionate.
verses.tsw_comparator: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; our God is compassionate.

verses.rationale: Renders simple as inexperienced rather than morally foolish.
verses.before: The LORD watches over the simple; I was brought low, and the LORD saved me.
verses.after: The LORD guards the inexperienced; when I was brought low, he saved me.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD watches over the simple; I was brought low, and the LORD saved me.

verses.rationale: Preserves self-address and the reason for rest.
verses.before: Return, my whole being, to your rest, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.after: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt generously with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Return, my whole being, to your rest, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

verses.rationale: Keeps the three bodily deliverances and shift to direct address.
verses.before: For you have delivered my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
verses.after: For you have rescued my life from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you have delivered my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

verses.rationale: Preserves walking and plural lands.
verses.before: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.after: I will walk before the LORD in the lands of the living.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.rationale: Takes the conjunction concessively while preserving belief amid speech.
verses.before: I trusted, even when I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
verses.after: I kept trusting even when I said, “I am deeply afflicted,”
verses.tsw_comparator: I trusted, even when I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the sweeping cry located in the speaker's alarm.
verses.before: I said in my alarm, “All mortals are liars.”
verses.after: when I said in my alarm, “Every human being is a liar.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I said in my alarm, “All mortals are liars.”

verses.rationale: Retains the repayment question and total benefits.
verses.before: What will I return to the LORD for all the LORD’s goodness to me?
verses.after: What can I give back to the LORD for all the good he has done for me?
verses.tsw_comparator: What shall I return to the LORD for all the LORD’s goodness to me?

verses.rationale: Keeps ritual cup and invocation without defining an unstated rite.
verses.before: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
verses.after: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves public fulfillment and all the people.
verses.before: I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all the LORD’s people.
verses.after: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all the LORD’s people.

verses.rationale: Renders precious as costly in the rescue context without making death desirable.
verses.before: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of the LORD’s faithful ones.
verses.after: Costly in the LORD’s eyes is the death of his faithful ones.
verses.tsw_comparator: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of the LORD’s faithful ones.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated servant, maternal status, and released bonds.
verses.before: O LORD, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the child of your servant woman. You have loosed my bonds.
verses.after: Please, LORD, I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You have loosened my bonds.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the child of your servant woman. You have loosed my bonds.

verses.rationale: Keeps sacrificial thanks and the repeated invocation.
verses.before: I will offer to you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
verses.after: I will offer you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will offer to you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Repeats verse 14 while carrying the location into verse 19.
verses.before: I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all the LORD’s people,
verses.after: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,
verses.tsw_comparator: I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all the LORD’s people,

verses.rationale: Preserves temple courts, direct address to city, and short name.
verses.before: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise YAH!
verses.tsw_comparator: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Keeps paired imperatives and universal audiences.
verses.before: Praise the LORD, all nations! Extol God, all peoples!
verses.after: Praise the LORD, all nations; extol him, all peoples!
verses.tsw_comparator: Praise the LORD, all nations! Extol God, all peoples!

verses.rationale: Retains mighty love toward us and enduring faithfulness.
verses.before: For great over us is God’s steadfast love, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.after: For his faithful love toward us is mighty, and the LORD’s faithfulness lasts forever. Praise YAH!
verses.tsw_comparator: For great over us is God’s steadfast love, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!

verses.rationale: Maintains the shared opening and closing thanksgiving formula.
verses.before: Give thanks to the LORD, for the LORD is good; for the LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.
verses.after: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his faithful love lasts forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give thanks to the LORD, for the LORD is good; for the LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.

verses.rationale: Preserves the first group's response.
verses.before: Let Israel say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”
verses.after: Let Israel say, “His faithful love lasts forever.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Let Israel say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”

verses.rationale: Keeps priestly household and repeated response.
verses.before: Let the house of Aaron say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”
verses.after: Let the house of Aaron say, “His faithful love lasts forever.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the house of Aaron say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the third audience and unchanged response.
verses.before: Let people who fear the LORD say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”
verses.after: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His faithful love lasts forever.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those who fear the LORD say, “The LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.”

verses.rationale: Keeps both short names and the spatial distress/deliverance contrast.
verses.before: Out of distress I called on the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me in a broad place.
verses.after: From a narrow place I called to YAH; YAH answered me with a wide-open place.
verses.tsw_comparator: Out of distress I called on the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me in a broad place.

verses.rationale: Preserves personal allegiance and rhetorical question.
verses.before: The LORD is for me; I will not fear. What can mortals do to me?
verses.after: The LORD is for me; I will not fear. What can a human being do to me?
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is for me; I will not fear. What can mortals do to me?

verses.rationale: Retains among my helpers and hostile observers' reversal.
verses.before: The LORD is for me among people who help me; therefore I will look in triumph on people who hate me.
verses.after: The LORD is for me among my helpers; I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is for me among those who help me; therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.

verses.rationale: Keeps refuge and trust as related but distinct verbs.
verses.before: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in mortals.
verses.after: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in a human being.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in mortals.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated first line and changed human object.
verses.before: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
verses.after: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in nobles.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

verses.rationale: Keeps comprehensive foes and the force of the cutting verb.
verses.before: All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.after: All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.tsw_comparator: All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

verses.rationale: Retains intensified encirclement and exact repeated response.
verses.before: They surrounded me—yes, they surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.after: They surrounded me, surrounded me on every side; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.tsw_comparator: They surrounded me—yes, they surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

verses.rationale: Keeps both swarm and quickly extinguished thorn-fire images.
verses.before: They surrounded me like bees; they were quenched like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.after: They surrounded me like bees; they went out like a fire of thorns. In the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.tsw_comparator: They surrounded me like bees; they were quenched like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

verses.rationale: Preserves abrupt second-person attacker rather than silently pluralizing.
verses.before: I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
verses.after: You pushed me hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

verses.rationale: Retains short divine name and traditional song reading with lexical note.
verses.before: The LORD is my strength and my song; the LORD has become my salvation.
verses.after: YAH is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is my strength and my song; the LORD has become my salvation.

verses.rationale: Keeps audible celebration, tents, and opening of the quoted refrain.
verses.before: Glad songs of salvation are in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand does valiantly!
verses.after: Shouts of joy and salvation rise from the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand acts valiantly!
verses.tsw_comparator: Glad songs of salvation are in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand does valiantly!

verses.rationale: Preserves both right-hand clauses and the repeated action.
verses.before: The LORD’s right hand is lifted up; the LORD’s right hand does valiantly!”
verses.after: The LORD’s right hand is lifted high! The LORD’s right hand acts valiantly!”
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD’s right hand is lifted up; the LORD’s right hand does valiantly!”

verses.rationale: Keeps the emphatic life/death contrast and testimony.
verses.before: I will not die, but live, and tell of the deeds of the LORD.
verses.after: I will not die; I will live and tell of YAH’s deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: I shall not die, but live, and tell of the deeds of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves intensified discipline without making it lethal.
verses.before: The LORD has disciplined me severely, but the LORD has not given me over to death.
verses.after: YAH disciplined me severely, but he did not hand me over to death.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD has disciplined me severely, but the LORD has not given me over to death.

verses.rationale: Keeps gate image, entry, and short name.
verses.before: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter through them and give thanks to the LORD.
verses.after: Open the gates of righteousness for me; I will enter through them and thank YAH.
verses.tsw_comparator: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter through them and give thanks to the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves singular gate and qualified entry.
verses.before: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter through it.
verses.after: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous may enter through it.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.

verses.rationale: Keeps direct thanksgiving and the repeated salvation claim.
verses.before: I give you thanks, for you have answered me and have become my salvation.
verses.after: I thank you because you answered me and became my salvation.
verses.tsw_comparator: I give you thanks, for you have answered me and have become my salvation.

verses.rationale: Preserves rejection-to-prominence without adding a later identification.
verses.before: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.after: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.tsw_comparator: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine origin and communal wonder.
verses.before: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.after: This has come from the LORD; it is wonderful in our eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.

verses.rationale: Preserves the shared clear formulation and paired joy verbs.
verses.before: This is the day that the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.after: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is the day that the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.rationale: Keeps both repeated pleas and distinct rescue/success requests.
verses.before: O LORD, save, we pray! O LORD, grant us success, we pray!
verses.after: Please, LORD, save us! Please, LORD, grant us success!
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, save, we pray! O LORD, grant us success, we pray!

verses.rationale: Preserves singular comer and plural recipients of priestly blessing.
verses.before: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD. We bless you from the house of the LORD.
verses.after: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD. We bless you from the house of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retains the difficult binding instruction and altar horns with alternatives noted.
verses.before: The LORD is God, and the LORD has given us light. Bind the festal procession with branches, up to the horns of the altar.
verses.after: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the festival offering with cords, up to the horns of the altar.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is God, and the LORD has given us light. Bind the festal procession with branches, up to the horns of the altar.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated personal confession and two responses.
verses.before: You are my God, and I will give you thanks; you are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.after: You are my God, and I will thank you; my God, I will exalt you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are my God, and I will give you thanks; you are my God, I will exalt you.

verses.rationale: Repeats the opening formula exactly.
verses.before: Give thanks to the LORD, for the LORD is good; for the LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.
verses.after: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his faithful love lasts forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give thanks to the LORD, for the LORD is good; for the LORD’s steadfast love endures forever.

verses.rationale: Keeps way/walk imagery and Torah as instruction.
verses.before: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.after: Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the LORD’s instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves testimonies and wholehearted seeking.
verses.before: Blessed are people who keep his testimonies, who seek him with their whole heart,
verses.after: Happy are those who keep his testimonies, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed are those who keep his testimonies, who seek him with their whole heart,

verses.rationale: Keeps conduct and walking parallelism.
verses.before: who also do no wrong, but walk in his ways.
verses.after: They do no wrong; they walk in his ways.
verses.tsw_comparator: who also do no wrong, but walk in his ways.

verses.rationale: Retains divine command and intensive observance.
verses.before: You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.
verses.after: You have commanded that your precepts be kept with great care.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.

verses.rationale: Preserves the wish rather than declaring achieved obedience.
verses.before: Oh that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!
verses.after: If only my ways were firmly directed toward keeping your decrees!
verses.tsw_comparator: Oh that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!

verses.rationale: Keeps conditional shame and all commands.
verses.before: Then I will not be put to shame, having my eyes fixed on all your commandments.
verses.after: Then I would not be ashamed as I attend to all your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I shall not be put to shame, having my eyes fixed on all your commandments.

verses.rationale: Retains learning as the setting of praise.
verses.before: I will praise you with an upright heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.after: I will thank you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will praise you with an upright heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

verses.rationale: Keeps resolve beside dependent petition.
verses.before: I will keep your statutes; do not utterly forsake me!
verses.after: I will keep your decrees; do not abandon me completely.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will keep your statutes; do not utterly forsake me!

verses.rationale: Preserves the male youth and question-answer form.
verses.before: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word.
verses.after: How can a young man keep his path pure? By guarding it according to your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word.

verses.rationale: Keeps wholehearted search and feared wandering.
verses.before: With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments!
verses.after: I have sought you with my whole heart; do not let me stray from your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments!

verses.rationale: Retains storing image and its stated purpose.
verses.before: I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.after: I have stored your utterance in my heart so that I may not sin against you.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.rationale: Keeps blessing joined to instruction request.
verses.before: Blessed are you, O LORD; teach me your statutes!
verses.after: Blessed are you, LORD; teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed are you, O LORD; teach me your statutes!

verses.rationale: Preserves speaker's lips and divine mouth.
verses.before: With my lips I declare all the judgments of your mouth.
verses.after: With my lips I recount all the judgments from your mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: With my lips I declare all the judgments of your mouth.

verses.rationale: Retains path and wealth comparison.
verses.before: In the way of your testimonies I delight as much as in all riches.
verses.after: I rejoice in the way of your testimonies as much as in all riches.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the way of your testimonies I delight as much as in all riches.

verses.rationale: Keeps meditation and attention as distinct acts.
verses.before: I will meditate on your precepts and fix my eyes on your ways.
verses.after: I will ponder your precepts and attend to your paths.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will meditate on your precepts and fix my eyes on your ways.

verses.rationale: Retains delight and resolve to remember.
verses.before: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word.
verses.after: I will delight in your decrees; I will not forget your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word.

verses.rationale: Preserves life and obedience as linked aims.
verses.before: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live and keep your word.
verses.after: Deal generously with your servant, so I may live and keep your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live and keep your word.

verses.rationale: Keeps uncovering eyes rather than substituting abstract understanding.
verses.before: Open my eyes, that I may look wondrous things out of your law.
verses.after: Uncover my eyes, so I may see wonders in your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.

verses.rationale: Retains alien status and hidden commands plea.
verses.before: I am a sojourner on the earth; hide not your commandments from me!
verses.after: I am a foreign resident on the earth; do not hide your commands from me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am a sojourner on the earth; hide not your commandments from me!

verses.rationale: Keeps crushing longing and continual duration.
verses.before: My soul is consumed with longing for your judgments at all times.
verses.after: My whole being is worn down with longing for your judgments at every moment.
verses.tsw_comparator: My soul is consumed with longing for your judgments at all times.

verses.rationale: Retains curse language and wandering conduct.
verses.before: You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, who wander from your commandments.
verses.after: You rebuke the arrogant, the accursed, who stray from your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, who wander from your commandments.

verses.rationale: Preserves rolling-away image and stated ground.
verses.before: Take away from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept your testimonies.
verses.after: Roll scorn and contempt away from me, for I have kept your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Take away from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept your testimonies.

verses.rationale: Keeps seated rulers and servant's contrasting attention.
verses.before: Even though princes sit plotting against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.after: Even when rulers sit plotting against me, your servant ponders your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: Even though princes sit plotting against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves instruction personified as counselors.
verses.before: Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors.
verses.after: Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors.

verses.rationale: Retains dust/death image and life plea.
verses.before: My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word!
verses.after: My life clings to the dust; keep me alive according to your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word!

verses.rationale: Keeps recounting, answer, and request sequence.
verses.before: When I told of my ways, you answered me; teach me your statutes!
verses.after: I told you of my ways, and you answered; teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: When I told of my ways, you answered me; teach me your statutes!

verses.rationale: Retains understanding leading to meditation.
verses.before: Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.after: Help me understand the way of your precepts, and I will ponder your wonders.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.

verses.rationale: Keeps dripping/draining life and sustaining plea.
verses.before: My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word!
verses.after: My life drains away in sorrow; raise me up according to your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word!

verses.rationale: Preserves false way and instruction as gracious gift.
verses.before: Put false ways far from me and graciously teach me your law!
verses.after: Keep the way of falsehood far from me; grant me your instruction graciously.
verses.tsw_comparator: Put false ways far from me and graciously teach me your law!

verses.rationale: Keeps deliberate choice and focused judgments.
verses.before: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I set your judgments before me.
verses.after: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set your judgments before me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I set your judgments before me.

verses.rationale: Echoes clinging in verse 25 with a changed object.
verses.before: I cling to your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame!
verses.after: I cling to your testimonies, LORD; do not let me be put to shame.
verses.tsw_comparator: I cling to your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame!

verses.rationale: Preserves running and enlarged-heart image.
verses.before: I will run in the way of your commandments when you enlarge my heart.
verses.after: I run along the way of your commands, for you give my heart room.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will run in the way of your commandments when you enlarge my heart.

verses.rationale: Retains path and enduring observance; end reading noted.
verses.before: Teach me, O LORD, the way of your statutes; and I will keep it to the end.
verses.after: Teach me, LORD, the way of your decrees, and I will keep it to the end.
verses.tsw_comparator: Teach me, O LORD, the way of your statutes; and I will keep it to the end.

verses.rationale: Keeps understanding and wholehearted double observance.
verses.before: Give me understanding, that I may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.
verses.after: Give me understanding, and I will keep your instruction, guarding it with my whole heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give me understanding, that I may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.

verses.rationale: Preserves guided path and delight as reason.
verses.before: Lead me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.
verses.after: Lead me along the path of your commands, for that is where I delight.
verses.tsw_comparator: Lead me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.

verses.rationale: Keeps inward inclination and exploitative profit contrast.
verses.before: Incline my heart to your testimonies, and not to selfish gain!
verses.after: Bend my heart toward your testimonies, not toward dishonest gain.
verses.tsw_comparator: Incline my heart to your testimonies, and not to selfish gain!

verses.rationale: Preserves eyes and life in the divine way.
verses.before: Turn my eyes from looking at worthless things; and give me life in your ways.
verses.after: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; keep me alive in your way.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn my eyes from looking at worthless things; and give me life in your ways.

verses.rationale: Takes relative clause with promise; alternative servant attachment noted.
verses.before: Confirm to your servant your promise, that you may be feared.
verses.after: Confirm your promise to your servant, the promise that calls forth fear of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Confirm to your servant your promise, that you may be feared.

verses.rationale: Keeps feared disgrace and goodness of judgments.
verses.before: Turn away the reproach that I dread, for your judgments are good.
verses.after: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for your judgments are good.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn away the reproach that I dread, for your judgments are good.

verses.rationale: Retains demonstrative plea and righteousness as basis.
verses.before: Look, I long for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life!
verses.after: See how I long for your precepts; keep me alive in your righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Behold, I long for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life!

verses.rationale: Keeps arriving love and parallel salvation.
verses.before: Let your steadfast love come to me, O LORD, your salvation according to your promise;
verses.after: Let your faithful love reach me, LORD, your salvation according to your promise.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let your steadfast love come to me, O LORD, your salvation according to your promise;

verses.rationale: Preserves verbal answer grounded in trust.
verses.before: then I will have an answer for him who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
verses.after: Then I can answer the one who scorns me, for I trust in your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: then I shall have an answer for him who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

verses.rationale: Keeps forceful removal image and hoped-for judgment.
verses.before: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in your judgments.
verses.after: Do not strip the word of truth entirely from my mouth, for I wait in hope for your judgment.
verses.tsw_comparator: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in your judgments.

verses.rationale: Retains the accumulated duration expressions.
verses.before: I will keep your law continually, forever and ever,
verses.after: I will keep your instruction continually, forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will keep your law continually, forever and ever,

verses.rationale: Preserves spacious walking image rather than only abstract freedom.
verses.before: and I will walk in a wide place, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.after: I will walk in a wide-open place, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: and I shall walk in a wide place, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.rationale: Keeps royal audience and unashamed witness.
verses.before: I will also speak of your testimonies before kings and will not be put to shame,
verses.after: I will speak of your testimonies before kings and will not be ashamed.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will also speak of your testimonies before kings and shall not be put to shame,

verses.rationale: Retains both delight and love without collapsing them.
verses.before: for I find my delight in your commandments, which I love.
verses.after: I delight in your commands, which I love.
verses.tsw_comparator: for I find my delight in your commandments, which I love.

verses.rationale: Preserves unusual raised-hands object and distinct terms.
verses.before: I will lift up my hands toward your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.after: I lift my hands toward your commands, which I love, and ponder your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will lift up my hands toward your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine initiation of hope.
verses.before: Remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.
verses.after: Remember the word to your servant on which you made me hope.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.

verses.rationale: Preserves comfort's explicit explanation.
verses.before: This is my comfort in my affliction, that your promise gives me life.
verses.after: This is my comfort in affliction: your promise has kept me alive.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is my comfort in my affliction, that your promise gives me life.

verses.rationale: Keeps intensified ridicule and steady course.
verses.before: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from your law.
verses.after: The arrogant mock me mercilessly, but I do not turn aside from your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from your law.

verses.rationale: Preserves ancient judgments as comfort's source.
verses.before: When I think of your judgments from of old, I take comfort, O LORD.
verses.after: I remember your judgments from long ago, LORD, and I find comfort.
verses.tsw_comparator: When I think of your judgments from of old, I take comfort, O LORD.

verses.rationale: Retains fierce emotion and its stated object.
verses.before: Hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.
verses.after: Burning indignation seizes me because of the wicked who abandon your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.

verses.rationale: Keeps musical instruction and sojourning setting.
verses.before: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.
verses.after: Your decrees have become my songs wherever I live as a foreigner.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.

verses.rationale: Preserves nighttime remembrance and practice.
verses.before: I remember your name in the night, O LORD, and keep your law.
verses.after: At night I remember your name, LORD, and keep your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: I remember your name in the night, O LORD, and keep your law.

verses.rationale: Leaves this minimally resolved rather than inventing a reward.
verses.before: This blessing has fallen to me, that I have kept your precepts.
verses.after: This has become mine: I keep your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: This blessing has fallen to me, that I have kept your precepts.

verses.rationale: Keeps portion metaphor and spoken commitment.
verses.before: The LORD is my portion; I promise to keep your words.
verses.after: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep your words.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is my portion; I promise to keep your words.

verses.rationale: Renders entreating the face as seeking favor.
verses.before: I entreat your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
verses.after: With my whole heart I seek your favor; be gracious to me according to your promise.
verses.tsw_comparator: I entreat your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.

verses.rationale: Keeps reflection and bodily redirection.
verses.before: When I think on my ways, I turn my feet to your testimonies;
verses.after: I have considered my ways and turned my feet toward your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: When I think on my ways, I turn my feet to your testimonies;

verses.rationale: Retains positive and negative urgency.
verses.before: I hasten and do not delay to keep your commandments.
verses.after: I hurry and do not delay to keep your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hasten and do not delay to keep your commandments.

verses.rationale: Keeps binding image and resistance through memory.
verses.before: Though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, I do not forget your law.
verses.after: The cords of the wicked entangle me, but I do not forget your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, I do not forget your law.

verses.rationale: Preserves exact time and reason for thanks.
verses.before: At midnight I rise to praise you, because of your righteous judgments.
verses.after: At midnight I rise to thank you for your righteous judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: At midnight I rise to praise you, because of your righteous judgments.

verses.rationale: Keeps broad fellowship tied to fear and practice.
verses.before: I am a companion of everyone who fear you, of people who keep your precepts.
verses.after: I am a companion to all who fear you, to those who keep your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.

verses.rationale: Retains worldwide love beside personal teaching plea.
verses.before: The earth, O LORD, is full of your steadfast love; teach me your statutes!
verses.after: The earth is full of your faithful love, LORD; teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth, O LORD, is full of your steadfast love; teach me your statutes!

verses.rationale: Keeps experienced goodness measured by word.
verses.before: You have dealt well with your servant, O LORD, according to your word.
verses.after: You have treated your servant well, LORD, according to your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have dealt well with your servant, O LORD, according to your word.

verses.rationale: Renders good taste as discernment with knowledge distinct.
verses.before: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.after: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I trust your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

verses.rationale: Preserves the speaker's temporal contrast, not a universal rule.
verses.before: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep your word.
verses.after: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; now I keep your utterance.
verses.tsw_comparator: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep your word.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine character and action separately.
verses.before: You are good and do good; teach me your statutes.
verses.after: You are good and you do good; teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are good and do good; teach me your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves smearing image and wholehearted response.
verses.before: The arrogant smear me with lies, but with my whole heart I keep your precepts;
verses.after: The arrogant smear me with lies; I keep your precepts with my whole heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: The arrogant smear me with lies, but with my whole heart I keep your precepts;

verses.rationale: Keeps the ancient fat-heart image with explanatory note.
verses.before: their heart is dull like fat, but I delight in your law.
verses.after: Their hearts are thick as fat, but I delight in your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: their heart is dull like fat, but I delight in your law.

verses.rationale: Retains personal assessment and learning purpose.
verses.before: It is good for me that I was afflicted, that I might learn your statutes.
verses.after: It was good for me to be afflicted, so that I might learn your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is good for me that I was afflicted, that I might learn your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves mouth and numerical wealth comparison.
verses.before: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
verses.after: Instruction from your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
verses.tsw_comparator: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.

verses.rationale: Keeps creation's two verbs and dependent learning.
verses.before: Your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that I may learn your commandments.
verses.after: Your hands made me and shaped me; give me understanding so I may learn your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that I may learn your commandments.

verses.rationale: Preserves observers' joy and its stated cause.
verses.before: People who fear you will see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in your word.
verses.after: Those who fear you will see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who fear you shall see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in your word.

verses.rationale: Keeps direct divine agency in affliction.
verses.before: I know, O LORD, that your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.after: I know, LORD, that your judgments are righteous and that in faithfulness you afflicted me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know, O LORD, that your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

verses.rationale: Preserves petition, promise, and servant relationship.
verses.before: Let your steadfast love comfort me according to your promise to your servant.
verses.after: Please let your faithful love comfort me, according to your promise to your servant.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let your steadfast love comfort me according to your promise to your servant.

verses.rationale: Keeps arriving compassion and life purpose.
verses.before: Let your compassion come to me, that I may live, for your law is my delight.
verses.after: Let your compassion reach me so I may live, for your instruction is my delight.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let your compassion come to me, that I may live, for your law is my delight.

verses.rationale: Preserves wished-for shame and deceptive wrong.
verses.before: Let the arrogant be put to shame, because they wrong me with falsehood; as for me, I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.after: Let the arrogant be ashamed, for they wronged me with lies; I will ponder your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the arrogant be put to shame, because they wrong me with falsehood; as for me, I will meditate on your precepts.

verses.rationale: Follows the read form those who know rather than written they will know.
verses.before: Let people who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.
verses.after: Let those who fear you turn to me, those who know your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.

verses.rationale: Keeps desired integrity and its purpose.
verses.before: May my heart be blameless in your statutes, that I may not be put to shame!
verses.after: May my heart be blameless in your decrees, so that I will not be ashamed.
verses.tsw_comparator: May my heart be blameless in your statutes, that I may not be put to shame!

verses.rationale: Retains consuming longing alongside hope.
verses.before: My soul longs for your salvation; I hope in your word.
verses.after: My whole being is worn out with longing for your salvation; I hope in your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: My soul longs for your salvation; I hope in your word.

verses.rationale: Preserves failing eyes and unanswered when.
verses.before: My eyes long for your promise; I ask, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.after: My eyes grow weary looking for your promise; I ask, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes long for your promise; I ask, “When will you comfort me?”

verses.rationale: Keeps unfamiliar damaged-container image with vocabulary support.
verses.before: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.
verses.after: Though I have become like a wineskin in smoke, I have not forgotten your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves mortality question and demand for judgment.
verses.before: How long must your servant endure? When will you judge people who persecute me?
verses.after: How many days does your servant have? When will you judge those who pursue me?
verses.tsw_comparator: How long must your servant endure? When will you judge those who persecute me?

verses.rationale: Keeps physical trap image and violation of instruction.
verses.before: The arrogant have dug pits for me, men who do not live according to your law.
verses.after: The arrogant have dug pits for me, contrary to your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: The arrogant have dug pits for me, men who do not live according to your law.

verses.rationale: Retains trustworthiness, unjust pursuit, and abrupt cry.
verses.before: All your commandments are faithful; they persecute me with falsehood; help me!
verses.after: All your commands are faithful; they pursue me with lies—help me!
verses.tsw_comparator: All your commandments are faithful; they persecute me with falsehood; help me!

verses.rationale: Keeps near destruction and refusal to forsake.
verses.before: They have almost made an end of me on earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
verses.after: They nearly finished me off on earth, but I did not abandon your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: They have almost made an end of me on earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

verses.rationale: Preserves singular testimony and divine mouth.
verses.before: In your steadfast love give me life, that I may keep the testimonies of your mouth.
verses.after: Keep me alive in your faithful love, and I will keep the testimony of your mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: In your steadfast love give me life, that I may keep the testimonies of your mouth.

verses.rationale: Keeps enduring heavenly stability.
verses.before: Forever, O LORD, your word is firmly fixed in the heavens.
verses.after: Forever, LORD, your word stands firm in the heavens.
verses.tsw_comparator: Forever, O LORD, your word is firmly fixed in the heavens.

verses.rationale: Preserves generational fidelity and established earth.
verses.before: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands fast.
verses.after: Your faithfulness lasts from generation to generation; you established the earth, and it stands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands fast.

verses.rationale: Keeps plural cosmic subject and universal service.
verses.before: By your appointment they stand this day, for everything are your servants.
verses.after: They stand to this day according to your judgments, for all things are your servants.
verses.tsw_comparator: By your appointment they stand this day, for all things are your servants.

verses.rationale: Preserves the counterfactual claim.
verses.before: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.after: If your instruction had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.tsw_comparator: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.rationale: Keeps lifelong remembrance grounded in life received.
verses.before: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
verses.after: I will never forget your precepts, for through them you have kept me alive.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.

verses.rationale: Preserves belonging before the rescue plea.
verses.before: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.after: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.rationale: Keeps lethal intent and contrasting attention.
verses.before: The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your testimonies.
verses.after: The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I attend to your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your testimonies.

verses.rationale: Preserves difficult perfection/limit contrast and spatial breadth.
verses.before: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.after: I have seen a limit to every perfection, but your command is exceedingly broad.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.

verses.rationale: Keeps exclamation and continual meditation.
verses.before: Oh how I love your law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.after: How I love your instruction! It occupies my thoughts all day.
verses.tsw_comparator: Oh how I love your law! It is my meditation all the day.

verses.rationale: Preserves singular command and comparative wisdom.
verses.before: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever with me.
verses.after: Your command makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is always with me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever with me.

verses.rationale: Keeps bold comparison without softening its claim.
verses.before: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.after: I have more insight than all my teachers, for your testimonies occupy my thoughts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

verses.rationale: Retains age-authority comparison grounded in practice.
verses.before: I understand more than the aged, for I keep your precepts.
verses.after: I understand more than the elders, because I keep your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I understand more than the aged, for I keep your precepts.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily restraint and stated purpose.
verses.before: I hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep your word.
verses.after: I hold my feet back from every evil path so that I may keep your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep your word.

verses.rationale: Preserves emphatic divine teacher.
verses.before: I do not turn aside from your judgments, for you have taught me.
verses.after: I do not turn aside from your judgments, for you yourself have taught me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I do not turn aside from your judgments, for you have taught me.

verses.rationale: Keeps taste organs and honey comparison.
verses.before: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.after: How sweet your utterance is to my palate, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.tsw_comparator: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.rationale: Preserves understanding's ethical consequence.
verses.before: Through your precepts I get understanding; so I hate every false way.
verses.after: Through your precepts I gain understanding; therefore I hate every false path.
verses.tsw_comparator: Through your precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

verses.rationale: Retains clear shared imagery without forced novelty.
verses.before: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
verses.after: Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

verses.rationale: Keeps oath and fulfillment distinct.
verses.before: I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous judgments.
verses.after: I have sworn an oath, and I will fulfill it: I will keep your righteous judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserves intensified suffering and direct appeal.
verses.before: I am severely afflicted; give me life, O LORD, according to your word!
verses.after: I am deeply afflicted; LORD, keep me alive according to your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am severely afflicted; give me life, O LORD, according to your word!

verses.rationale: Keeps speech as voluntary sacrificial offering.
verses.before: Accept my freewill offerings of praise, O LORD, and teach me your judgments.
verses.after: Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, LORD, and teach me your judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: Accept my freewill offerings of praise, O LORD, and teach me your judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserves danger idiom literally with vocabulary explanation.
verses.before: I hold my life in my hand continually, but I do not forget your law.
verses.after: My life is always in my hand, but I do not forget your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hold my life in my hand continually, but I do not forget your law.

verses.rationale: Keeps trap and wandering contrast.
verses.before: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your precepts.
verses.after: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your precepts.

verses.rationale: Preserves inheritance metaphor and enduring delight.
verses.before: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.after: I have taken your testimonies as my inheritance forever, for they are my heart’s joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

verses.rationale: Keeps intentional inclination and doubled duration.
verses.before: I incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end.
verses.after: I incline my heart to carry out your decrees forever, to the end.
verses.tsw_comparator: I incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end.

verses.rationale: Preserves the divided-person object and hate/love contrast.
verses.before: I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.
verses.after: I hate the divided-hearted, but I love your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.

verses.rationale: Keeps both protective metaphors.
verses.before: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.
verses.after: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.

verses.rationale: Preserves dismissal and personal God designation.
verses.before: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.after: Leave me, you evildoers, so I may keep my God’s commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

verses.rationale: Keeps support, life, and feared disappointed hope.
verses.before: Uphold me according to your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope!
verses.after: Support me according to your promise, so I may live; do not let my hope end in shame.
verses.tsw_comparator: Uphold me according to your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope!

verses.rationale: Retains dependent rescue and sustained attention.
verses.before: Hold me up, that I may be safe and have regard for your statutes continually!
verses.after: Hold me up, and I will be saved; I will attend to your decrees continually.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hold me up, that I may be safe and have regard for your statutes continually!

verses.rationale: Keeps rejection and the source's emphatic deceit/lie wording.
verses.before: You spurn everyone who go astray from your statutes, for their cunning is in vain.
verses.after: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.tsw_comparator: You spurn all who go astray from your statutes, for their cunning is in vain.

verses.rationale: Preserves metal-refining waste image and stated response.
verses.before: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross, so I love your testimonies.
verses.after: You remove all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross, therefore I love your testimonies.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily trembling and fear's divine object.
verses.before: My flesh trembles for fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments.
verses.after: My flesh shudders in dread of you; I fear your judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: My flesh trembles for fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserves claimed conduct and requested protection.
verses.before: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.after: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.

verses.rationale: Keeps legal surety image with vocabulary support.
verses.before: Give your servant a pledge of good; let not the arrogant oppress me.
verses.after: Stand as guarantor for your servant’s good; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give your servant a pledge of good; let not the arrogant oppress me.

verses.rationale: Retains exhausted watching and two awaited objects.
verses.before: My eyes long for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.
verses.after: My eyes grow weary looking for your salvation and for your righteous promise.
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes long for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.

verses.rationale: Keeps love as measure and servant's learning need.
verses.before: Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
verses.after: Treat your servant according to your faithful love, and teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves identity, requested capacity, and purpose.
verses.before: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies!
verses.after: I am your servant; give me understanding so that I may know your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies!

verses.rationale: Keeps third-person LORD then direct address; alternative syntax noted.
verses.before: It is time for the LORD to act, for your law has been broken.
verses.after: It is time for the LORD to act; they have broken your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is time for the LORD to act, for your law has been broken.

verses.rationale: Preserves inference and intensified gold comparison.
verses.before: So I love your commandments above gold, above fine gold.
verses.after: That is why I love your commands more than gold, even pure gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I love your commandments above gold, above fine gold.

verses.rationale: Retains awkward comprehensive wording rather than dropping its scope.
verses.before: So I consider all your precepts to be right; I hate every false way.
verses.after: That is why I count all your precepts right in every matter; I hate every false path.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I consider all your precepts to be right; I hate every false way.

verses.rationale: Keeps wonder as reason for committed observance.
verses.before: Your testimonies are wonderful; so my soul keeps them.
verses.after: Your testimonies are wonderful; that is why I keep them with my whole being.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.

verses.rationale: Preserves opening/light image and teachable simple people.
verses.before: The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
verses.after: The opening of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the inexperienced.
verses.tsw_comparator: The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily desire image rather than abstract interest.
verses.before: I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commandments.
verses.after: I open my mouth and pant, so deeply do I long for your commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commandments.

verses.rationale: Renders judgment contextually as customary treatment.
verses.before: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your way with people who love your name.
verses.after: Turn toward me and be gracious to me, as is your way with those who love your name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your way with those who love your name.

verses.rationale: Preserves steps and evil's dominion image.
verses.before: Keep steady my steps according to your promise, and let no iniquity get dominion over me.
verses.after: Make my steps firm according to your promise; do not let any wrongdoing rule over me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Keep steady my steps according to your promise, and let no iniquity get dominion over me.

verses.rationale: Keeps redemption and human oppressors explicit.
verses.before: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may keep your precepts.
verses.after: Redeem me from human oppression, so I may keep your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may keep your precepts.

verses.rationale: Preserves blessing's face-light image.
verses.before: Make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.
verses.after: Let your face shine on your servant, and teach me your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.

verses.rationale: Keeps tears as streams and the source of grief.
verses.before: My eyes shed streams of tears, because people do not keep your law.
verses.after: Streams of water run from my eyes because people do not keep your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes shed streams of tears, because people do not keep your law.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine character and corresponding decisions.
verses.before: Righteous are you, O LORD, and right are your judgments.
verses.after: You are righteous, LORD, and your judgments are upright.
verses.tsw_comparator: Righteous are you, O LORD, and right are your judgments.

verses.rationale: Keeps command, righteousness, and intensified fidelity.
verses.before: You have appointed your testimonies in righteousness and in all faithfulness.
verses.after: You have commanded your testimonies in righteousness and in utter faithfulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have appointed your testimonies in righteousness and in all faithfulness.

verses.rationale: Preserves consuming zeal and enemies' forgetfulness.
verses.before: My zeal consumes me, because my foes forget your words.
verses.after: My zeal consumes me, because my foes have forgotten your words.
verses.tsw_comparator: My zeal consumes me, because my foes forget your words.

verses.rationale: Keeps tested-metal image rather than ungrounded certainty language.
verses.before: Your promise is well tried, and your servant loves it.
verses.after: Your promise has been thoroughly refined, and your servant loves it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your promise is well tried, and your servant loves it.

verses.rationale: Retains low status and steadfast memory.
verses.before: I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.
verses.after: I am small and despised, but I do not forget your precepts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.

verses.rationale: Keeps deliberate repeated righteousness and truth assertion.
verses.before: Your righteousness is righteous forever, and your law is truth.
verses.after: Your righteousness is righteous forever, and your instruction is truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your righteousness is righteous forever, and your law is truth.

verses.rationale: Preserves paired pressures and contrasting delight.
verses.before: Trouble and anguish have found me out, but your commandments are my delight.
verses.after: Trouble and distress have overtaken me, but your commands are my delight.
verses.tsw_comparator: Trouble and anguish have found me out, but your commandments are my delight.

verses.rationale: Keeps enduring rightness and life-seeking understanding.
verses.before: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding that I may live.
verses.after: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding so I may live.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding that I may live.

verses.rationale: Retains wholehearted cry and resolve.
verses.before: With my whole heart I cry; answer me, O LORD! I will keep your statutes.
verses.after: I call with my whole heart; answer me, LORD. I will keep your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: With my whole heart I cry; answer me, O LORD! I will keep your statutes.

verses.rationale: Preserves direct call followed by rescue and observance.
verses.before: I call to you; save me, that I may observe your testimonies.
verses.after: I call to you; save me, and I will keep your testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: I call to you; save me, that I may observe your testimonies.

verses.rationale: Follows singular read form word and early rising.
verses.before: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your words.
verses.after: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your word.
verses.tsw_comparator: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your words.

verses.rationale: Keeps watch periods and meditation's timing.
verses.before: My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promise.
verses.after: My eyes are awake before the night watches, so I may ponder your promise.
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promise.

verses.rationale: Preserves parallel according-to grounds with distinct terms.
verses.before: Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; O LORD, give me life according to your justice.
verses.after: Hear my voice according to your faithful love; LORD, keep me alive according to your judgment.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; O LORD, give me life according to your justice.

verses.rationale: Keeps near/far contrast rather than only persecution.
verses.before: They draw near who persecute me with evil purpose; they are far from your law.
verses.after: Those who pursue evil schemes draw near; they are far from your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: They draw near who persecute me with evil purpose; they are far from your law.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine nearness answering verse 150.
verses.before: But you are near, O LORD, and all your commandments are true.
verses.after: You are near, LORD, and all your commands are truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you are near, O LORD, and all your commandments are true.

verses.rationale: Keeps past learning and permanent establishment.
verses.before: Long have I known from your testimonies that you have founded them forever.
verses.after: Long ago I learned from your testimonies that you established them forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Long have I known from your testimonies that you have founded them forever.

verses.rationale: Preserves seeing as appeal and memory as ground.
verses.before: Look on my affliction and deliver me, for I do not forget your law.
verses.after: See my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten your instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look on my affliction and deliver me, for I do not forget your law.

verses.rationale: Keeps legal advocacy, redemption, and life request.
verses.before: Plead my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise!
verses.after: Plead my case and redeem me; keep me alive according to your promise.
verses.tsw_comparator: Plead my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise!

verses.rationale: Preserves distance metaphor and stated reason.
verses.before: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.
verses.after: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your decrees.
verses.tsw_comparator: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.

verses.rationale: Keeps plural judgments and abundant mercy.
verses.before: Great is your mercy, O LORD; give me life according to your judgments.
verses.after: Your compassion is abundant, LORD; keep me alive according to your judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: Great is your mercy, O LORD; give me life according to your judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserves numerous opponents and unchanged course.
verses.before: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, but I do not swerve from your testimonies.
verses.after: My pursuers and foes are many, but I do not turn aside from your testimonies.
