verses.before: Let burning coals fall upon them; let them be cast into fire, into deep pits, never to rise.
verses.after: Let burning coals fall on them; let him cast them into fire, into deep pits from which they cannot rise.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let burning coals fall upon them; let them be cast into fire, into deep pits, never to rise.

verses.rationale: Keeps tongue-man idiom and evil as hunter.
verses.before: Let the slanderer not be established in the land; let evil hunt down the violent swiftly.
verses.after: Let the slanderer gain no foothold in the land; let evil hunt the violent man down to his ruin.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the slanderer not be established in the land; let evil hunt down the violent swiftly.

verses.rationale: Follows first-person read form and preserves judicial support.
verses.before: I know that the LORD maintains the cause of the afflicted and justice for the poor.
verses.after: I know the LORD will uphold the cause of the afflicted and justice for the needy.
verses.tsw_comparator: I know that the LORD maintains the cause of the afflicted and justice for the poor.

verses.rationale: Keeps thanks and dwelling before God.
verses.before: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name; the upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.after: Surely the righteous will thank your name; the upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.tsw_comparator: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name; the upright will dwell in your presence.

verses.rationale: Preserves title and repeated call with urgency.
verses.before: O LORD, I call to you; hasten to me. Give ear to my voice when I call to you.
verses.after: A psalm of David. LORD, I call to you; hurry to me. Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, I call to you; hasten to me. Give ear to my voice when I call to you.

verses.rationale: Keeps two worship comparisons and evening time.
verses.before: Let my prayer be set before you as incense, the lifting of my hands as the evening offering.
verses.after: Let my prayer stand before you like incense, my lifted hands like the evening offering.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let my prayer be set before you as incense, the lifting of my hands as the evening offering.

verses.rationale: Preserves guard and doorway images.
verses.before: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
verses.after: Set a guard over my mouth, LORD; keep watch at the door of my lips.
verses.tsw_comparator: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.

verses.rationale: Keeps inward, active, and dining temptations distinct.
verses.before: Do not incline my heart toward an evil thing, to practice wicked deeds with people who do evil; let me not eat their delicacies.
verses.after: Do not incline my heart toward anything evil, to take part in wicked deeds with evildoers; do not let me eat their delicacies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not incline my heart toward an evil thing, to practice wicked deeds with those who do evil; let me not eat their delicacies.

verses.rationale: Preserves difficult correction/oil sequence and uncertain final attachment in note.
verses.before: Let the righteous strike me—it is steadfast love; let one rebuke me—it is oil for my head; let my head not refuse it. Yet my prayer is still against their evil deeds.
verses.after: Let a righteous person strike me—it is faithful love; let him correct me—it is oil on my head. Let my head not refuse it, for my prayer is still against their evil deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the righteous strike me—it is steadfast love; let one rebuke me—it is oil for my head; let my head not refuse it. Yet my prayer is still against their evil deeds.

verses.rationale: Retains violent obscure clause without inventing a narrative referent.
verses.before: When their judges are thrown down beside the rock, then they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.
verses.after: When their judges are thrown down along the sides of a cliff, they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.
verses.tsw_comparator: When their judges are thrown down beside the rock, then they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.

verses.rationale: Keeps first-person plural bones and agricultural death image.
verses.before: As when one plows and breaks open the earth, so our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
verses.after: As when someone plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
verses.tsw_comparator: As when one plows and breaks open the earth, so our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

verses.rationale: Preserves both names and pouring-out death plea.
verses.before: But my eyes are toward you, O LORD my Lord; in you I take refuge. Do not pour out my life.
verses.after: But my eyes are toward you, LORD, my Lord; in you I take refuge. Do not pour out my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: But my eyes are toward you, O LORD my Lord; in you I take refuge. Do not pour out my life.

verses.rationale: Keeps trap's hand/grip and plural snares.
verses.before: Keep me from the trap they have laid for me and from the snares of people who do evil.
verses.after: Keep me from the grip of the trap they have laid for me, from the snares of evildoers.
verses.tsw_comparator: Keep me from the trap they have laid for me and from the snares of those who do evil.

verses.rationale: Retains collective fall and speaker's passage, with pronoun uncertainty noted.
verses.before: Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I pass by safely.
verses.after: Let the wicked fall together into their nets while I pass through.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I pass by safely.

verses.rationale: Binds separate title and first body record, retaining cave and repeated voice/name.
verses.before: With my voice I cry to the LORD; with my voice I plead to the LORD for mercy.
verses.after: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. With my voice I cry to the LORD; with my voice I plead with the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: With my voice I cry to the LORD; with my voice I plead to the LORD for mercy.

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled before-him and pouring image.
verses.before: I pour out my complaint before God; I tell my trouble before God.
verses.after: I pour out my complaint before him; I tell my trouble before him.
verses.tsw_comparator: I pour out my complaint before God; I tell my trouble before God.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine knowledge amid weakness and hidden danger.
verses.before: When my spirit grows faint within me, you know my path. On the way where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
verses.after: When my spirit grows faint within me, you yourself know my path. On the road I walk, they have hidden a trap for me.
verses.tsw_comparator: When my spirit grows faint within me, you know my path. On the way where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.

verses.rationale: Preserves imperative, right side, and repeated abandonment.
verses.before: Look to my right and see: there is no one who recognizes me. Refuge has vanished from me; no one cares for my life.
verses.after: Look to my right and see: no one acknowledges me. No refuge remains for me; no one cares for my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look to my right and see: there is no one who recognizes me. Refuge has vanished from me; no one cares for my life.

verses.rationale: Keeps refuge and inheritance metaphors within living land.
verses.before: I cry to you, O LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.after: I cry to you, LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I cry to you, O LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

verses.rationale: Preserves both reasons for urgent rescue.
verses.before: Attend to my cry, for I have been brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
verses.after: Attend to my cry, for I am brought very low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are stronger than I am.
verses.tsw_comparator: Attend to my cry, for I have been brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

verses.rationale: Keeps confinement image without assuming a literal jail.
verses.before: Bring my life out of prison, so that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will gather around me because you deal bountifully with me.
verses.after: Bring my life out of confinement so I may thank your name. The righteous will gather around me, for you will deal generously with me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bring my life out of prison, so that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will gather around me because you deal bountifully with me.

verses.rationale: Preserves title and paired appeals grounded in divine attributes.
verses.before: O LORD, hear my prayer; give ear to my pleas for mercy. In your faithfulness answer me, in your righteousness.
verses.after: A psalm of David. LORD, hear my prayer; listen to my pleas. In your faithfulness answer me, in your righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, hear my prayer; give ear to my pleas for mercy. In your faithfulness answer me, in your righteousness.

verses.rationale: Keeps judicial plea and universal living-person claim.
verses.before: Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no one living is righteous before you.
verses.after: Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no living person is righteous before you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no one living is righteous before you.

verses.rationale: Preserves violent pursuit and prolonged-death comparison.
verses.before: For the enemy has pursued my life; he has crushed my life to the ground. He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
verses.after: The enemy pursues my life; he crushes me to the ground and makes me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the enemy has pursued my life; he has crushed my life to the ground. He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

verses.rationale: Keeps two inward organs and distinct distress terms.
verses.before: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is appalled.
verses.after: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is appalled inside me.
verses.tsw_comparator: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is appalled.

verses.rationale: Preserves remembrance and two reflection verbs.
verses.before: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all you have done; I ponder the work of your hands.
verses.after: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all you have done and ponder the work of your hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all you have done; I ponder the work of your hands.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily gesture, dry-earth comparison, and marker.
verses.before: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah.
verses.after: I spread my hands toward you; my whole being thirsts for you like parched land. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah.

verses.rationale: Preserves urgency, hidden face, and underworld comparison.
verses.before: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like people who go down to the Pit.
verses.after: Answer me quickly, LORD; my spirit is failing. Do not hide your face from me, or I will become like those who go down to the Pit.
verses.tsw_comparator: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like those who go down to the Pit.

verses.rationale: Keeps morning hearing, path guidance, and lifted life.
verses.before: Let me hear of your steadfast love in the morning, for in you I trust. Make known to me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
verses.after: Let me hear your faithful love in the morning, for I trust in you. Make known the way I should walk, for to you I lift my whole being.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let me hear of your steadfast love in the morning, for in you I trust. Make known to me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.

verses.rationale: Renders difficult covered-to-you expression as seeking shelter with note.
verses.before: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; to you I have fled for refuge.
verses.after: Rescue me from my enemies, LORD; to you I flee for shelter.
verses.tsw_comparator: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; to you I have fled for refuge.

verses.rationale: Keeps obedience request and spatial guidance image.
verses.before: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
verses.after: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Let your good spirit lead me on level ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

verses.rationale: Preserves name and righteousness as parallel grounds.
verses.before: For your name’s sake, O LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.after: For your name’s sake, LORD, keep me alive; in your righteousness bring my life out of trouble.
verses.tsw_comparator: For your name’s sake, O LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.rationale: Keeps lethal petition and servant rationale without softening.
verses.before: In your steadfast love cut off my enemies and destroy everyone who afflict my life, for I am your servant.
verses.after: In your faithful love, put an end to my enemies; destroy all who afflict my life, for I am your servant.
verses.tsw_comparator: In your steadfast love cut off my enemies and destroy all who afflict my life, for I am your servant.

verses.rationale: Preserves title and actual martial training.
verses.before: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for battle and my fingers for war,
verses.after: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for battle, my fingers for war.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for battle and my fingers for war,

verses.rationale: Keeps stacked metaphors and singular my people of the pinned text.
verses.before: my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield and the One in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
verses.after: He is my faithful love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
verses.tsw_comparator: my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield and the One in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

verses.rationale: Preserves parallel human frailty and divine attention.
verses.before: O LORD, what is a human being, that you know them, a mortal, that you think of them?
verses.after: LORD, what is a human being that you know him, a mortal that you take account of him?
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, what is a human being, that you know them, a mortal, that you think of them?

verses.rationale: Keeps two transience images.
verses.before: A human being is like a breath; one’s days are like a passing shadow.
verses.after: A human being is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
verses.tsw_comparator: A human being is like a breath; one’s days are like a passing shadow.

verses.rationale: Preserves cosmic descent and smoking touch.
verses.before: O LORD, bow your heavens and come down; touch the mountains so that they smoke.
verses.after: LORD, bend your heavens and come down; touch the mountains so they smoke.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, bow your heavens and come down; touch the mountains so that they smoke.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine weapons and two hostile outcomes.
verses.before: Flash lightning and scatter them; send out your arrows and rout them.
verses.after: Flash lightning and scatter them; send your arrows and throw them into confusion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Flash lightning and scatter them; send out your arrows and rout them.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine hands, drowning image, and human hand.
verses.before: Stretch out your hand from on high; rescue me and deliver me from mighty waters, from the hand of foreigners,
verses.after: Stretch your hands down from on high; free me and rescue me from mighty waters, from the hand of foreigners,
verses.tsw_comparator: Stretch out your hand from on high; rescue me and deliver me from mighty waters, from the hand of foreigners,

verses.rationale: Keeps mouth and oath-hand imagery without adding an explicit oath.
verses.before: whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a right hand of lies.
verses.after: whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a hand of lies.
verses.tsw_comparator: whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a right hand of lies.

verses.rationale: Preserves new song and exact instrument-string count.
verses.before: O God, I will sing a new song to you; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to you,
verses.after: God, I will sing you a new song; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music for you,
verses.tsw_comparator: O God, I will sing a new song to you; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to you,

verses.rationale: Keeps royal rescue and David's explicit third-person name.
verses.before: the One who gives victory to kings, who rescues David, the servant, from the cruel sword.
verses.after: you who give kings victory, who free David your servant from the deadly sword.
verses.tsw_comparator: the One who gives victory to kings, who rescues David, the servant, from the cruel sword.

verses.rationale: Preserves the repeated appeal and description of verses 7–8.
verses.before: Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a right hand of lies.
verses.after: Free me and rescue me from the hand of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a hand of lies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hand is a right hand of lies.

verses.rationale: Keeps both gendered images and takes the transition as communal wish.
verses.before: May our sons in their youth be like plants grown to full stature, and our daughters like corner pillars, carved for the structure of a palace.
verses.after: May our sons be like plants grown tall in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved for a palace.
verses.tsw_comparator: May our sons in their youth be like plants grown to full stature, and our daughters like corner pillars, carved for the structure of a palace.

verses.rationale: Preserves abundance, both numerical scales, and outdoor flocks.
verses.before: May our storehouses be full, providing every kind of produce. May our sheep multiply by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields.
verses.after: May our storehouses be full, supplying every kind of produce; may our flocks multiply by thousands and tens of thousands in our fields.
verses.tsw_comparator: May our storehouses be full, providing every kind of produce. May our sheep multiply by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields.

verses.rationale: Keeps difficult laden-cattle and civic phrases open with alternatives noted.
verses.before: May our cattle bear without mishap, with no breach and no going out, and no cry of distress in our streets.
verses.after: May our cattle be laden with increase; may there be no breach, no going out, no cry of distress in our squares.
verses.tsw_comparator: May our cattle bear without mishap, with no breach and no going out, and no cry of distress in our streets.

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled happiness and climactic divine allegiance.
verses.before: Happy are the people for whom it is so; happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.after: Happy is the people for whom it is so; happy is the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Happy are the people for whom it is so; happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

comparative_references.scope: All 714 TSW verses read after independent drafting from each selected Hebrew record and all annotations. Shared wording is retained where clear; overlap is triage only.
